x-okf-proposal-guidance.summary: a new capability: something users or callers cannot do today.
x-okf-proposal-guidance.question: Does the source argue for a capability the system does not yet have?
signals: a user or caller outcome is described that no current path delivers
the change adds behaviour rather than repairing it
one design, plan and branch can deliver it
anti_signals: the system already does this and does it wrongly
the change only restructures existing code
the outcome needs several independently shippable pieces
